Notes: Not counted: needs adjacent Summons or Decoys.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Summon or Decoy.

Notes: Builds up with deaths and kills; counted as one stack with traits triggered (like Act of Faith).
Ability_Text: Ûthar gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage each time a friendly character dies or kills an enemy unit. Once Ûthar crits, this bonus resets.

Notes: Not counted: a Summon makes the attack.
Ability_Text: After the relic bearer performs a normal attack, a friendly adjacent Summon performs a normal attack against an enemy in range, if possible. If the summon is a Daemon, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage with this attack.

Notes: Not counted: needs an adjacent unit to die.
Ability_Text: The first time each turn that any unit adjacent to Nicodemus dies, he heals himself and all friendly adjacent units for {[hp]} Health. All affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with normal melee attacks until the end of this turn.

Notes: Pierce grows with each of her attacks; counted as one stack from her second attack. Reusing her active is not counted.
Ability_Text: Each time Re'vas attacks, she gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset, and Re'vas can use her active ability again.

Notes: Not counted: Armour builds up with its own attacks.
Ability_Text: Each time the relic bearer attacks, it gains +{[extraArmor]} Armour. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset and the relic bearer can use its active ability again.

Notes: Not counted: +Damage depends on allies' ranged attacks; the repair needs a kill.
Ability_Text: Commander Farsight's melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time another friendly Character within {[range]} hexes has performed a ranged attack this turn. When Commander Farsight kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he repairs himself for {[hpToHeal]} Health.

Notes: Not counted: builds up with kills.
Ability_Text: Boss Gulgortz and all friendly Ork Boyz deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks for each enemy unit that Boss Gulgortz has defeated in this battle.

Notes: Not counted: helps the next attack by any unit after his active; reuse needs kills.
Ability_Text: Herald of the Apocalypse always adds Despoiled Ground to the hexes of affected enemies, and the next attack against affected enemies also ignores {[armorIgnored]} Armour. After Herald of the Apocalypse has been used and Haarken defeats {[nrOfUnits]} enemy units, he can use the ability again.

Notes: +Crit Damage per Suppressed/Stunned/Taunted/Thrilled unit nearby; counted as one with traits triggered.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each unit within range {[range]} that is Suppressed, Stunned, Taunted, or Thrilled, up to a maximum of {[nrOfUnits]} times. This bonus is doubled if the relic bearer is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health.

Notes: Not counted: needs adjacent friendly Mechanical units.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Mechanical unit.

Notes: His melee attacks Contaminate the target's hex (-30% Armour) for his later attacks. The Poxwalkers (summons) are not counted.
Ability_Text: Typhus' normal melee attacks add Contamination to the target's hex. During his turn, when a non-mechanical enemy unit within Typhus' Contagion aura is killed, he summons a Poxwalker in the hex of the defeated unit, as long as there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Poxwalkers on the battlefield. The Poxwalkers have {[summonHp]} Health and {[summonDmg]} Damage.

Notes: If he has not moved: attacks that crit add a Direct hit (with traits triggered). Moving after attacking is not counted.
Ability_Text: During his turn, if Maugan Ra has not moved, he can move after attacking and his attacks that contain a Crit deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage. When Overwatching, Crits deal this additional hit if he has not moved in his last turn.

Owners: Parasite of Mortrex; The Patermine; Tyrant Guard; Winged Prime
Notes: Not counted: needs adjacent Summons.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each adjacent Summon.

Notes: +Damage vs Big Targets and Vehicles; his own extra block chance (he has no block item).
Ability_Text: Forcas deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage to Big Targets and Vehicles. He also has an added {[blockChance]}% chance to Block {[blockDmg]} Damage.

Notes: Not counted: needs adjacent friendly Mechanical units; Living Metal regeneration is between turns.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent friendly Mechanical unit and regenerates an additional {[hpToHeal]} Health from Living Metal.

Notes: Not counted: helps allies; the extra Neuroparasite level is beyond the one level counted.
Ability_Text: The maximum level of Neuroparasite is increased by {[effectLevel]}. Other friendly Psykers within Synapse range and friendly Summons within Synapse range deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage to enemies that are affected by Neuroparasite.

Notes: Contaminates the target's hex (-30% Armour), so from the second attack the target also takes the extra Toxic hits.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer's normal attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to enemy units that have their Armour reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is Contaminated.

Notes: Attacks a random enemy at the start of her turn; counted on the target. Crits dealing maximum damage is not counted.
Ability_Text: All of Tyrith's hits that are Crits deal the maximum possible Damage. At the beginning of Tyrith's turn, she attacks a random enemy within range {[range]} and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. If there is an enemy adjacent to her, this range is reduced to 1.

Notes: Not counted: summons.
Ability_Text: After moving, if there is no friendly Necron Warrior on the battlefield, Anuphet summons a Necron Warrior in a free adjacent hex. If Anuphet does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn. After My Will Be Done triggers, it triggers a second time, but only a friendly adjacent Necron Warrior that was not affected by it this turn can perform an attack. The Necron Warriors have {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.

Notes: Revives once per battle: counted as extra health.
Ability_Text: The first time each battle that Aethana is defeated, she is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health remaining, even if Overkilled.

Owners: Bellator; Cyrus; Ramus; Sarquael; Sword Brother Godswyl; Titus; Tjark
Notes: Melee pierce and ranged Crit Damage, doubled vs Chaos or Xenos targets.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with melee attacks and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage with ranged attacks. These bonuses are doubled against Chaos or Xenos enemies.

Notes: Not counted: suppresses/stuns the enemies it hits, which the model only counts for actives.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer's attacks that deal Power Damage have a {[chance]}% chance to Suppress and a {[chance_2]}% chance to Stun enemies targeted by them. These chances are doubled if the attack is an active ability.

Owners: Kut Skoden; Sibyll Devine; Thaddeus Noble
Notes: Not counted: summons and allies.
Ability_Text: Friendly surrounding Imperial Summons have Final Vengeance. When the relic bearer is defeated, summons a Cadian Guardsman in its hex with {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.

Notes: Not counted: needs charging and defeated allies.
Ability_Text: When Dreir or Death Riders adjacent to Dreir are charging, their attacks Suppress their targets for 1 round. After charging and until the start of their next turn, they additionally have +{[extraArmor]} Armour for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle.

Notes: Less Crit Damage taken per adjacent enemy; counted as one. Being healable is not counted.
Ability_Text: The relic bearer can be healed as well as repaired and additionally takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent enemy unit.

Notes: Less Crit Damage taken per Blessings of Khorne level; counted at 4 levels with traits triggered.
Ability_Text: Each time the relic bearer defeats an enemy with a melee attack, it counts twice for Blessings Of Khorne. The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each level of Blessings Of Khorne.

Notes: Not counted: the extra hits go to other adjacent enemies, not the target.
Ability_Text: When Abaddon performs a normal melee attack, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Abaddon.

Notes: Not counted: needs a kill.
Ability_Text: The first time each turn that Celestine defeats an enemy unit, she resurrects one of her Geminae Superia with {[hp]} Health in a free adjacent hex. If they cannot be resurrected, then one of them within {[range]} hexes takes an action instead.

Notes: His melee attack (and passive) set the target on Fire; his next melee attack gets +Damage. Counted on every attack after the first.
Ability_Text: The hexes of each enemy hit by Mephiston's normal melee attack or by Fury of the Ancients are set on Fire. If these attacks hit enemies on hexes with Fire, they deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and extinguish the Fire.

Notes: Not counted: needs repairs.
Ability_Text: After Vynn or friendly E-COGs have performed +{[nrOfRepairs]} repairs, Vynn heals for {[hpToHeal]} Health and can use his active ability again.

Notes: Not counted: needs heals during his turn.
Ability_Text: During his turn, each time Baldr or an adjacent friendly unit gets healed for the first time this turn, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack. These attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and add Ice to the target's hex.
